Commentary.Commentary: Right. That ends another thrilling game. India earn their third win and romp into the semis. Who will be the next team? New Zealand? Australia? Or someone else? It is a tough passage. The second game of the day is between Australia and Bangladesh which will begin at 7 pm local (0800 GMT). Do join us for that game.

Harmanpreet Kaur, the Indian skipper, says that it is a great feeling and they have learnt a lot from the last three games. On batting better in overs 7 to 15, Kaur says that they got a good start but they could not carry the momentum forward. Stresses that they kept on repeating the mistakes in all the games. On the bowling, the Indian skipper says that they bowled well but sometimes they struggled to hit the right lines and lengths. On Shafali Varma, Kaur hopes that she continues performing well as her runs at the start is really important for them.

Sophie Devine, the New Zealand skipper, says that she thought that the bowlers did a terrific job and to restrict India to 133 was an amazing effort. Adds that the pitch looked a bit pacy but they failed to adapt. Praises Hayley Jensen for her performance. States that they got pretty close today but failed at the last moment. Goes onto say that they would take the positives from this game.

Shafali Verma, the Player of the Match, says that she is very happy with her performance and she wants to keep doing that for the team. Adds that they were not giving any loose balls and she was just looking to take singles and doubles. Credits her father and the boys in her academy where she trained for her good performances.

The White Ferns would be disappointed, not because of the loss but the mannerism of the defeat. They bounced back superbly after a strong second-wicket stand by India but then, kept dropping catches. Adapting to slow, turning pitches has been a challenge for many teams and the opponents are increasingly finding it difficult to play the Indian spinners. Four spinners played in this game and their combined figures were 16-0-106-4. Shikha Pandey, the lone seamer, did well with figures of 4-0-21-1. Please stay tuned for the presentation...

Kudos to New Zealand for fighting hard and taking this close but they could have won if, had the fielding been better or had the batting against spinners got going. As has been the case throughout the tournament, India crossed 130 and then defended it. They bowled better and fielded exceedingly well.

OUT! Confusion in the end but INDIA WIN AND ARE THROUGH TO THE SEMIS! Pandey bowls this full and outside off, Amelia gets across, looks to swing but misses and is hit on the pads. The ball deflects to the off side and all they can manage is just a leg bye. Shikha quickly gets to the ball and fires a throw at the keeper's end. Hits and it is referred upstairs. Replays show that Jensen was looking for the second while Kerr was not interested at all. VICTORY BY 3 RUNS!

FOUR! 5 needed from the final ball! These are some exhibition of nerves. Full and outside off, Kerr brings out the reverse paddle and scoops it over short third man! Are we in for a Super Over? A boundary will do it!
Full and on middle, pushed through mid on for just one. 9 needed from 2.
Misses out on a full toss, swinging it straight to mid on for a single. 10 needed from 3.
CATCH DROPPED! Full and outside off, Jensen hammers it straight back. Shikha tries to catch but cannot. The ball bursts through her hands to long off and it is a run.
FOUR! Good start to the over! 12 needed from 5. A length ball, outside off, Jensen throws her bat at it and gets a thick inside edge. The ball misses the stumps and goes past short fine leg!
Shikha Pandey to bowl the final over. 3-0-10-1 so far. 15 to defend.
FOUR! 18 from the over! Full and outside off, Kerr reaches out and lofts it over cover for another boundary! A rare expensive over from Poonam Yadav - 4-0-32-1 today.
FOUR! Third boundary of the over! Lobbed up outside off, Kerr comes down the track, takes it on the full and drives it through the covers.
Once again, Kerr attempts the paddle-pull by getting well outside off but this time the length is pretty full. Amelia misses.
FOUR! For the second time in the over! Again, Kerr waits for the ball to arrive after getting across. Picks the length and heaves it over short fine leg!
Full and outside off, lofted wide of long off. Good running stop by Deepti Sharma to her left. Two runs taken.
FOUR! THWACK! Short and outside off, extremely slow in pace, Kerr goes back, waits, waits, waits and pulls it over short fine leg!
Poonam Yadav to bowl out. 3-0-14-1 so far.

TWO RUN OUTS MISSED ON THE SAME BALL! Full and outside off, Kerr drives this straight back to the bowler. Jensen is backing up too far and is gone for all money. But Deepti, for all her time-taking and under-arming, misses the stumps at the bowler's end. They go for the single now and mid on quickly gets to the ball. Because Jensen tried to get back, she is a bit late in taking off. The throw comes in to the keeper's end but it hits Jensen who comes in the way.
Full and around middle, Kerr looks to slog but gets a thick inside edge onto her pads. Thinks of a run but is sent back.
Full and outside off, Jensen gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts it over covers. Sweeper gets across to her left and dives, keeping the ball in play. Three runs taken.
Full and outside off, pushed down to long off for one more.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a single. 39 more needed from 16 balls.
Outside off, Jensen looks to cut but misses.
Comes down the track and works it through mid-wicket for a couple. 4-0-25-1 for Radha Yadav.
Works this through mid-wicket for a run.
Short and outside off, cut through point where Rajeshwari Gayakwad dives to her left and parries it to short third man. Just a single.
Hayley Jensen comes in for the final rites.

OUT! CAUGHT IN THE DEEP! The last recognized batter departs as well and India have one-and-a-half feet into the semi-finals. Short and outside off, Martin comes down the track and swings it powerfully over mid-wicket. The connection sounds good but when the ball completes the trajectory, Jemimah Rodrigues is there to take the sitter! Martin goes for a fighting 25 from 28 balls. New Zealand fighting a losing cause - 44 more needed from 21 balls.
FOUR! THUNDEROUS! Full and outside off, Martin swings this over mid-wicket and splits the fielders in the deep!
Full and outside off, Martin looks to drive but gets a thick inside edge onto her pads.
Radha Yadav to bowl out now. 3-0-17-0 so far. Shafali Verma is seen sitting in the dugout. Nasser Hussain on air informs that she has hurt her elbow.
Comes down the track and works it through mid-wicket for a run.
Sees the batter come down the track and fires it wide outside off. Martin can only drive it back to the bowler.

Short and outside off, hit straight to Poonam Yadav at short third man. The initial call is NO but Martin calls Kerr through for a quick single. Poonam is very slow to release the ball and the run is completed with ease. 49 needed from 26 balls.
FOUR! Gets it through this time! Full and outside off, Kerr reaches out and drives it between cover and point and finds the gap.
Short and outside off, Kerr looks to cut but misses. There is a mild appeal for a caught behind but the umpire is not interested.
Full and outside off, Martin mistimes her slog towards deep square leg for a single. Moves to 20 from 23 balls.
Deepti Sharma is back on. 2-0-14-1 so far.
Full and outside off, Martin comes down the track and drives it towards long off for one more. Just 2 runs and a wicket from the over, Rajeshwari finishes with figures of 4-0-22-1!
Short and outside off, cut powerfully but straight to point.
Short and outside off, Kerr looks to cut but gets a thick outside edge. The ball lands in front of short third man and the batters cross over.
Outside off, guided straight to short third man.
Who is in next? Amelia Kerr to face the music.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Excellent take from Taniya Bhatia. Full and outside off, Green comes down the track, looks to go inside out but misses. The keeper collects and whips the bails off. It appears that it is a stumping but then we are informed that it is a catch. Snickometer confirms. The good-looking 43-run stand has been broken. New Zealand need 57 from 34 balls.
Full and outside off, Green looks to sweep but misses.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad returns. 3-0-20-0 so far.

INSIDE EDGE, MISSES THE STUMPS! And an overthrow is conceded as well. Poor backup by Deepti Sharma. Full and outside off, Martin gets across, initially looking to paddle but then, seeing the line wide outside off, she looks to run it down to third man. All she manages is a thick inside edge which misses the stumps and goes to short fine leg. The fielder comes running in, has a shy at the striker's end but misses. Deepti Sharma lazily jogs to her right from short extra cover and makes no attempt to stop the ball. Allows it to go through to long off and the batters return for the second.
Full and outside off, driven down powerfully but long on is pretty straight. Just a single.
On middle and off, hit down to long on for one more.
Full and straight, whipped through mid-wicket for a run.
Full and outside off, powered down to long off for a single.
A length ball, outside off, Martin looks to run it down to third man but the ball swings away and beats the outside edge.
Shikha Pandey is back on. 2-0-4-1 so far.
Outside off, punched wide of cover for a single.
FOUR! Finally she connects well. Full and outside off, Martin gets down and across and sweeps it powerfully through mid-wicket.
Gets a long way across her stumps and Poonam tosses this outside off. It is punched straight to cover.
This time she connects with the sweep but finds short mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, Martin looks to sweep but misses.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a single.
Poonam Yadav returns. 2-0-8-1 so far.
Outside off, tapped away for a quick run.
SIX! THUMP! Full and around off, Green comes down the track and sends it sailing over deep mid-wicket!
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for one.

TOP EDGE, SAFE! Shikha Pandey loses it in the sun. Full and outside off, Green looks to play the slog sweep but gets a top edge. The ball lobs in the air towards square leg but Pandey running across from short mid-wicket loses it in the sun and backs off. Strange. She has the glasses on, but on the cap. Why not wear them over the eyes? A single taken.

Bob Carter, the New Zealand batting coach, is down for an interview with Nasser Hussain. Carter says that they will take it ball by ball and keep the scorecard ticking over. Says that they made a couple of great stops in the field but also dropped some catches which should have been taken, otherwise the ground fielding was excellent. On being asked whether it would be nice if they win without Devine contributing, the coach chuckles and then agrees.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to short extra cover.
In the air... but safe. Full and around off, Martin looks to play the paddle but gets it off something, over the keeper. The batters take a single, leg bye signalled.
FOUR! Second boundary of the over. 79 needed from 54 now. Short and outside leg, Green rocks back, swivels and pulls it through fine leg. The stand is worth 21 from 17 balls.
Comes down the track, is beaten in flight, is nowhere near the pitch of the ball and just jabs it to the leg side. It is just beside the pitch and the batters take a quick run.
Short and outside off, cut towards point again.
Full and outside off, Katey comes down the track and pushes it towards short third man.
Short and outside off again, Martin looks to cut but misses.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries for New Zealand. Short and outside off, Martin rocks back and cuts it through point. Finds the gap and beats sweeper!
Rajeshwari Gayakwad into the attack now. 2-0-11-0 so far.
FOUR! Finds the gap. Short and down the leg side, Green goes back and pulls it behind square leg. Beats the fielder and gets it to the ropes.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Comes down the track and flicks it towards mid-wicket. The fielder fumbles and that results in a run.
Around off, well blocked out.
Comes down the track, looks to go downtown but mistimes it. Luckily for her, the ball lands exactly in between mid-wicket running back and long on running in. A run taken.
Full on middle, pushed towards the bowler.
WIDE. Fired down the leg side, Green misses her sweep.
Full and outside off, chipped over the bowler towards long off for a single.
Short again, punched off the back foot for a run.
Outside off, short in length, punched through the covers for a single.
Action replay of the previous delivery.
Full on middle, Green pushes this towards long on for a single.
Katey Martin walks in at number 5, replacing Devine.

OUT! CAUGHT! Taken off a full toss! Once again, the Indian spinners are having their say. Floated outside off, Devine comes down the track and takes it on the full. That is a high full toss to boot. 9 times out of 10, that would have gone out of the park. But does not happen today. Devine mistimes this very badly and the ball lobs off the top edge. Simple catch for Radha Yadav at point. New Zealand losing their way - need 100 more from 71 balls.
Works this through mid-wicket for a single.
Comes down the track but can only push it back to the bowler.
Fires it into middle, following the batter down the leg side, Devine goes back and looks to punch but gets a bottom edge.
Full and down the leg side, worked straight to short mid-wicket.
Tossed up outside off, Devine comes down the track and hammers it straight back to the bowler. She is struggling.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Radha Yadav to bowl for the first time.

SAFE. Full and outside off, Green lunges to defend but misses. The ball loops and then spins away. Bhatia collects and whips the bails off, appealing. It is referred upstairs but replays show that the foot did go in the air but was back quickly.
Is that a stumping? Terrific glovework from Taniya Bhatia. Referred upstairs. Safe.
Outside off, watchfully pushed to the off side.
Comes down the track and pushes this to long on for one.
Full and outside off, excellent flight and dip in pace, Maddy opens the face of the bat and runs it wide of short third man for a run.
Outside off, punched straight to cover.
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
Here comes the strike bowler. Poonam Yadav to bowl.
Outside off, pushed straight to cover. New Zealand finish the Powerplay on 30/2. India were 49/1 at this stage. The Kiwis need 104 from 84 balls.
Full and outside off, Green looks to run it down to third man but misses due to the lack of pace.
Maddy Green walks in, with the rub of the green going India's way.

OUT! BOWLED! Paddled onto the stumps! Bates would be furious with herself. Full and outside off, Bates gets a long way across and looks to paddle. But she simply does not get any pace to work with. All she manages to do is hit it straight onto the stumps! Big, big wicket for India. New Zealand need 104 from 86 balls.
Another single, eased down to long on.
Full and around off, well blocked out.
Comes down the track and pushes it towards long on for a single.
Deepti Sharma gets a change of ends. 1-0-12-0 are her figures so far.
Around off, watchfully defended.
Excellent bowling. Devine comes down the track and seeing that, Gayakwad fires it outside off. But Sophie adjusts and pushes it towards cover.
Outside off, played through point for a quick run.
Outside off, played through point for a single.
FOUR! Up and over. Full and outside off, Devine comes down the track and lofts it over mid off for a boundary!
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
EDGED AWAY! Outside off, on a length, Bates looks to punch but the ball moves away and takes the outside edge. The ball goes through the vacant slip cordon towards third man. Two runs taken.
Outside off, punched off the back foot.
Comes down the track and swings hard but misses it.
Full on middle, pushed towards mid on.

NOT OUT. India lose a review. A length ball, down the leg side, Devine looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. Shikha appeals but the umpire does not raise his finger. The bowler wants a review but the keeper advises against it. The captain goes with the bowler but Ball Tracker shows it to be missing leg stump.
Review for LBW! Shikha wants the review, but keeper Bhatia says no. Skipper Kaur goes with the bowler.
This is worked through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Down the leg side, Devine tickles it to the fine leg fence.
Full and down the leg side, Bates jumps down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Comes down the track and Gayakwad fires it in the blockhole. Squeezed out.
Another full ball, outside off, well defended.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad into the attack now.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover. Just a run and a wicket from the over.
Around off, defended watchfully.
Suzie Bates walks in.

OUT! CAUGHT! There goes the first wicket. Full and outside off, Priest looks to play the slog but gets a top edge. The ball goes high in the air and Radha Yadav takes it calmly. India needed this wicket as Priest was threatening to play quickly. 121 more needed from 110 balls.
Short ball on the pads, Priest looks to pull but it takes the thigh pad and rolls to the keeper.
Good length ball on off, Priest defends it to cover.
Good length ball on off, Devine guides it to the point region for a single.
Shikha Pandey will bowl from the other end.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point. A fine start for the Kiwis.
FOUR! Terrific shot. Full and outside off, Priest gets down and sweeps it powerfully through mid-wicket!

TOP EDGE, SAFE! Good effort in the deep. Full and outside off, Priest gets down to sweep but gets a top edge. It lobs over the keeper. Shikha Pandey gets to the ball from short third man and pulls it back in. Three runs taken.
Full and outside off, Rachel fetches this and sweeps this to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! New Zealand are underway! Short and outside off, Priest rocks back and cuts it through the covers. The fielder dives inside the ring but the ball goes through.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.

The players are back out in the middle. The Indians walk out in a good mood, so that shows that they are not too disappointed with the opportunity of not getting to 150. Sophie Devine and Rachel Priest will open the batting for New Zealand. Interesting choice from the Indians. Deepti Sharma has been given the ball.
